## AGENDA

1. Open meeting and roll call (5 minutes)
2. Approval of minutes of August 26 meeting (5 minutes)
3. Treasurer's update (10 minutes)
4. Vote to extend current board officers to January meeting and discussion of board roles (20 minutes)
5. Review and discuss grant evaluation tool (40 minutes)
6. Overview of November and December meetings (10 minutes)
headline: Vote on extending board officers, review of grant evaluation tool, and overview of upcoming meetings.
summary: The council will give a treasurer's update, vote to extend current board officers to the January meeting, and discuss board roles. Members will also review a grant evaluation tool and preview the November and December meetings.
